# Werewolf Combat Techniques
Werewolves are stealthy nocturnal predators, hiding among the crew until the time is right. After transforming, they gain the [textlink="martial art" link="MartialArts"] Lycanthrope CQC, a set of vicious techniques that tear flesh and break bones.
## Combo attacks
### Open Veins
Mauls the victim with claws, dealing Slash damage and causing severe bleeding.
### Vicious Toss
Hurls the opponent a considerable distance and knocks them down.
### Dismemberment
Tears off one of the opponent's arms. Does not work a second time on someone whose arm you have already torn off.
